title: Preparing for a festival
topic: They are talking about festival practice. What will the man bring?
levelRationale: N5-oriented polite everyday speech with simple requests, time/place expressions and explicit contrasts. Follow the announced focus rather than remembering every detail. Vocabulary tips identify potentially unfamiliar spoken words; this is not an official JLPT vocabulary or difficulty certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、質問の答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen and choose one answer to the question.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: お祭りの練習について話しています。男の人は、何を持って行きますか。
turns.translation: They are talking about festival practice. What will the man bring?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 明日のお祭りの練習は、学校の庭ですね。初めてなので、何を持って行くか分かりません。
turns.translation: Tomorrow's festival practice is in the schoolyard, right? It's my first time, so I don't know what to bring.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 太鼓と棒は学校にあります。自分で持って来なくても大丈夫ですよ。
turns.translation: The drums and sticks are at school. You don't need to bring your own.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: そうですか。お昼ご飯はどうしますか。一日中、練習するんですか。
turns.translation: I see. What about lunch? Will we practice all day?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: いいえ、午前中だけです。十二時には終わりますから、お弁当はいりません。
turns.translation: No, just in the morning. We'll finish by twelve, so you don't need a packed lunch.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 分かりました。暑そうですね。飲み物をたくさん持って行ったほうがいいですか。
turns.translation: Understood. It looks as though it will be hot. Should I bring plenty to drink?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 冷たい水はこちらで用意します。汗をかきますから、タオルを一枚持って来てください。
turns.translation: We'll provide cold water. Please bring a towel, because you'll sweat.

options.label: タオル
options.rationale: This is the item she expressly asks him to bring in t6.

options.label: 太鼓と棒
options.rationale: These are already at the school.

options.label: お弁当
options.rationale: Practice ends by noon, so lunch is unnecessary.

options.label: 冷たい水
options.rationale: The organizers will supply the water.

explanation: Distinguish things supplied at the site from the personal towel requested in t6.
